ai.overview: Athletic Bilbao put their lineal championship belt on the line when they host Espanyol on November 22, 2026. The belt, which changes hands with every defeat and has been tracked game-by-game since La Liga's inception, is currently in its third game of Bilbao's latest reign after two successful defenses. Espanyol, who have held the belt 60 times previously, will look to claim it once again in what has historically been a tight rivalry.
key_matchups: Athletic Bilbao's unbeaten three-game stretch at home before their recent draws versus Espanyol's two-game losing streak
Bilbao's defensive solidity shown in the 3–0 win over Atlético Madrid and 2–0 win at Celta Vigo against Espanyol's recent struggles to keep games close
The head-to-head history slightly favors Athletic Bilbao (74-68-36 in 178 meetings), but Espanyol won both meetings in 2026 and 2025
ai.betting_angles: Athletic Bilbao enter as Elo favorites with superior recent form, having tied their last 2 games after posting shutout wins over Atlético Madrid and Celta Vigo. Espanyol have lost their last 2 games and carry a 2-4-1 record compared to Bilbao's 2-2-2 mark. However, the head-to-head history shows Espanyol won both recent meetings 2-0 and 2-1, suggesting they've found success against Bilbao despite their current struggles.
ai.prediction_writeup: Athletic Bilbao should retain the belt playing at home against a struggling Espanyol side. While Espanyol won both recent meetings, Bilbao's recent form is considerably stronger, with draws against Deportivo Alavés and Elche CF following impressive shutout victories over Atlético Madrid and Celta Vigo. Espanyol have lost their last 2 games and carry a losing record of 2-4-1 this season. The Elo model favoring Bilbao combined with home advantage and superior current form should be enough to secure a third belt defense, likely by a clean sheet margin similar to their recent wins.
